fields.gap: The knee is the tabulated interval with the largest drop in least SF per 100 kg of payload. It is a finite difference on these margins, not a fitted optimum.
fields.direction: A denser margin grid if a later card needs a smoother knee.
fields.effect: The named knee can move if margins are added between 0 and 5 percent.
